items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: Dr. Crozant told me one time that... my grandmother lived in Exposition Boulevard all the time. She traveled all over the world with the Solari's. Every time she had a child, Miss Solari would have one. She was a wet nurse.

ctx.x: I just wondered what the- if you knew anything about that great grandfather. No. So-

Dr. Crozant told me one time that the only Peche is he was a- was a bishop, and the bishop had a brother, so my grandmother might have- his name was Peche, Bishop Peche, and he had a brother. And my grandmother lived in Exposition Boulevard all the time. She traveled all over the world with the Solari's. Every time she had a child, Miss Solari would have one. She was a wet nurse. You see, a long time ago, they used wet names. Yeah, that's right. I heard about it. My grandmother, I know that she had one son, and…

Um, let's see. This is some information, I guess, from your uncle Monette had told Lomax once, about the- the Jell-Roll's father, Lamont, played slide trombone. Did you ever know the- No. The Jell-Roll playing any other instruments? No. He said he played a little bit on guitar and- I wouldn't know that, no. He never mentioned anything to you about it. Or in Chicago, you wouldn't have seen him play any other instruments? No. Drums or- No.
